title: Ethereum just hit a new all-time high and nobody noticed

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Ethereum's all-time high shows its protocol is stronger than ever — the future is on-chain.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Nobody noticed because most people are still using legacy systems, not Ethereum's complex smart contracts.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Ethereum's Layer 2 scaling solutions and EIP-1559 have made it more efficient — the network is evolving.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even with upgrades, Ethereum's high gas fees and slow transaction times keep it from mainstream adoption.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The rise is real — the protocol's resilience and DeFi growth prove Ethereum is the standard, not the exception.
